{
  "dataset_name": "qsar_biodegradation",
  "model_family": "linear_svm",
  "schema_generator": "gemini-3-pro",
  "schema_version": "1.0",
  "features": [
    {
      "name": "v1_v2_ratio",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ratio of V1 to V2, providing a relative scale between these two continuous measurements, smoothed by a small constant to prevent division by zero.",
      "value_range": [0.2, 8.0],
      "feature_family": "ratio",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Linear SVMs benefit from ratio features that capture the interaction and relative magnitude of two variables in a single continuous dimension.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "V1 / (V2 + 0.1)"
    },
    {
      "name": "v8_v30_diff",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Difference between V8 and V30, capturing the linear divergence between these two high-variance features.",
      "value_range": [-72.0, 61.0],
      "feature_family": "difference",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a direct linear projection that an SVM can easily weight to find an optimal separating hyperplane.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "V8 - V30"
    },
    {
      "name": "v15_v39_sum",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Sum of V15 and V39, creating a composite magnitude feature from two similarly scaled variables.",
      "value_range": [9.0, 28.0],
      "feature_family": "composite",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Aggregates correlated or additive effects into a single smooth feature, reducing dimensionality and improving margin stability.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "V15 + V39"
    },
    {
      "name": "v12_magnitude",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Absolute value of V12, transforming a feature with both positive and negative values into a pure magnitude scale.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 6.0],
      "feature_family": "magnitude",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Allows the linear model to capture symmetric effects around zero without needing a non-linear kernel.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.abs(V12)"
    },
    {
      "name": "v31_log_transform",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Logarithmic transformation of V31 to compress its long tail and reduce the impact of extreme outliers.",
      "value_range": [0.3, 3.0],
      "feature_family": "transformation",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Linear SVMs are sensitive to outliers; log-transforming skewed features helps regularize the feature space and stabilize the decision boundary.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.log1p(V31)"
    },
    {
      "name": "v36_v13_ratio",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ratio of V36 to V13, capturing the proportional relationship between these two continuous features.",
      "value_range": [0.3, 7.0],
      "feature_family": "ratio",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Creates a smooth, continuous interaction term that can be linearly weighted by the SVM.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "V36 / (V13 + 0.1)"
    },
    {
      "name": "v8_standardized_approx",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Approximate standardization of V8 using its training set mean and standard deviation.",
      "value_range": [-4.1, 2.7],
      "feature_family": "normalization",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Standardized features ensure that the SVM margin is not dominated by features with arbitrarily large scales.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(V8 - 37.0) / 9.1"
    },
    {
      "name": "v30_capped",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "V30 capped at an upper bound of 30.0 to mitigate the effect of extreme high values.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 30.0],
      "feature_family": "clipping",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Prevents large outlier values from disproportionately influencing the SVM's margin and support vectors.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip(V30, 0.0, 30.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "v1_v15_interaction",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Multiplicative interaction between V1 and V15, scaled down by a factor of 10.",
      "value_range": [0.8, 8.2],
      "feature_family": "interaction",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides the linear model with a pre-computed non-linear interaction term, expanding its representational capacity.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(V1 * V15) / 10.0"
    },
    {
      "name": "v12_v28_composite",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Weighted linear combination of V12 and V28.",
      "value_range": [-11.0, 11.0],
      "feature_family": "composite",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Acts as a pre-calculated linear projection that can simplify the optimization landscape for the SVM.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "V12 + (V28 * 5.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "molecular_complexity_estimate",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic assessment of molecular complexity based on the magnitude and variance of features like V8, V30, and V31.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 10.0],
      "feature_family": "semantic_assessment",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a holistic, continuous severity measure that captures underlying domain concepts not easily expressed by simple arithmetic.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "structural_stability_index",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic evaluation of structural stability derived from the balance and interplay of features V1, V2, V13, and V36.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "semantic_assessment",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Offers a normalized, smooth score representing a high-level structural property, ideal for linear margin separation.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    }
  ]
}
